zh.text: 托肯赞助卡片的微信收款码更换为 wechat.png
客户端改用原生 /noconsole 直连启动，不再弹出 CCP 控制台窗口；客户端日志改存 _launcher\logs\client 并实时显示在客户端页签
角色「登录启动」通过 /autoSelectCharacter:<角色ID> 直达所选角色，不再停留在角色选择
账号管理新增「创建角色」入口：无角色账号可一键进入游戏角色创建，创建完成后启动器自动刷新账号列表

en.text: Replaced the WeChat donation QR on the sponsor card with wechat.png
Client now launches directly with the native /noconsole switch so the CCP console window no longer appears; client output is stored under _launcher\logs\client and streamed live to the client log tab
Character launch now passes /autoSelectCharacter:<characterID> so the client enters the selected character directly instead of stopping at character select

Added a Create Character entry in account management: accounts without characters jump straight into the in-game character creation, and the launcher refreshes the account list once the character is created
